name: Myconian Utopia Resort
insider_take: This clifftop sanctuary commands the most dramatic views on Mykonos, where infinity pools seem to spill directly into the Aegean Sea and every suite feels like your own private Greek island retreat.
whats_special: Perched on Elia Beach's golden cliffs, this Relais & Châteaux property features cascading infinity pools that create a mesmerizing waterfall effect down the hillside. Each suite boasts private pools and unobstructed sea views, while the resort's signature Buddha-Bar Beach brings world-class dining and nightlife to your doorstep. The property's unique terraced design ensures complete privacy despite its impressive scale.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at the resort's cliff-edge restaurant during the full moon - the combination of moonlight reflecting off your private pool and the twinkling lights of distant islands creates pure magic.
dont_miss: The resort's exclusive beach club access at Elia Beach, one of Mykonos' longest and most pristine stretches of sand. Take advantage of the complimentary yacht transfers to Mykonos Town, and time your return for golden hour when the white Cycladic buildings glow against the deep blue sky.
pros: Stunning panoramic views of the Aegean Sea
Exceptional fine dining with Relais & Châteaux standards
Elegant suites and villas with private pools
